messages:
Liam K: FYI — NorthWave (paid, renewal ~20d) hit a hard stop during admin invite flow. Their webhook for provisioning returns 502 and the UI shows \"Invite failed\". Raising to CS for priority handoff.
Marisol V: Oof. Are they on Dedicated or Hosted? Any Billing contact?
Liam K: Hosted. Billing contact is ops@northwave.com per their contract. Ticket #5129 opened with request body and logs: https://tickets.internal/5129. Error snippet: `POST /external/provision -> 502 Bad Gateway`
Devon C: I pulled logs: their webhook endpoint times out (TCP RST) intermittently when we proxy. Repro 3/5 attempts. Possible network flap at their side after a recent infra change.
Nora S: Can we offer a temporary bypass so they can continue onboarding? We need to reduce churn risk — they're onboarding 40 seats and have a $60k ARR renewal in 20d.
Liam K: Support suggestion: issue a one-time invite token flow (email link) to allow admins to join without hitting the webhook. Ops approval needed.
Marisol V: Proposed comms + triage:
- CS owner: Marisol V (primary to exec + billing)
- Support owner: Devon C (ticket + logs)
- Short-term fix: generate one-time admin invite tokens (scope: org:northwave, 48h validity)
- Ops: monitor for repeated webhook failures and optionally whitelist Redwood IPs if they want
- AM (Nora): draft renewal note + empathy language + credit offer if this delays go-live
Agree?
deploy-bot: Action queued: create one-time invite token for `northwave-org`. Request ID r-zz102.
Devon C: Repro steps in ticket: run `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/northwave/invite -d '{\"email\":\"admin@northwave.com\"}'` -> 502. Logs show `upstream read timeout`. Trying fallback path to bypass webhook; ETA ~3h for dev patch.
Marisol V: Action items (owners):
- Nora S: draft renewal outreach + proposed 10% one-time credit (EOD)
- Ops: approve r-zz102 token creation and monitor (ASAP)
- Devon C: deploy fallback invite patch to staging (3h), validate
- Marisol V: schedule 30-min admin troubleshooting call tomorrow 09:00 PT
Nora S: I'll draft empathetic outreach: acknowledge the disruption, offer token bypass + 10% credit if onboarding extends beyond 7 days, propose joint troubleshooting call. Will send to legal for quick review.
Liam K: Risk note: churn exposure estimated ~20% if they can't finish onboarding. Mark P1 -> escalate if token not issued within 2h.
deploy-bot: Request r-zz102 completed: one-time invite tokens generated (10 tokens). Completed by ops-user at 2024-10-12T18:02:14Z.
Devon C: Fallback invite patch pushed to staging and validated (all invites succeed without webhook). Deploy to prod scheduled in 2h pending final checks.
Marisol V: Great. Once prod patch is live, I'll send the outreach and run the admin session. Nora, please share the draft here before sending.
Nora S: Draft posted in ticket thread. Short version: \"We're sorry — quick temporary invite tokens are available, and our team will stay on the call until SSO/webhook is stable. We value your partnership and will apply a goodwill credit if needed.\" :heart:
Liam K: Thanks team. Keep updates in ticket #5129 and paste here for visibility. If prod deploy slips, we'll escalate to eng on-call.
Devon C: Prod deploy complete, verification checks pass. Invites sent and accepted by 8/10 admins. Closing loop with customer now. /me breathes out :sweat_relief:
